big_case.notes: Routine First-Conference denial of a non-precedential Second Circuit summary order enforcing a single-station NLRB bargaining order over whether television producers are statutory supervisors under 29 U.S.C. 152(11). While Question Presented 2 framed a nationally salient Loper Bright standard-of-review question off a stray pre-Loper Bright deference quotation, the panel's actual holding rested on substantial-evidence review of localized factual gaps, the Second Circuit had already adopted Loper Bright for NLRB review in a published opinion 64 days later (Siren Retail), the Solicitor General waived a response, zero amici filed, and the Court denied certiorari without relist or dissent.
